results.title: What are Legislative Councils, and what role do they play in India’s State legislatures?
results.content: What are Legislative Councils, and what role do they play in State legislatures? This explainer looks at their constitutional basis, composition and powers. It also examines Tamil Nadu’s experience with the abolition and revival of its Legislative Council. What reforms have been proposed for these second chambers?

results.title: From Korean fiction to Ambedkar, National Book Trust report maps Gen Z reading habits
results.content: NBT report based on sample survey of visitors to Delhi book fair, of which 40% were college students; best-sellers included global fiction, self-help titles, Hindi classics; regional language literature suffers from publisher availability constraints

results.title: Jantar Mantar is a road, not a site, says Delhi Police chief
results.content: In an affidavit in the Supreme Court, Delhi Police Commissioner says none can insist on a right to protest only at a specific site and the State has power to change venue

results.title: Arunachal Pradesh gets new DGP days after violent protest against Siang dam
results.content: Rajesh Kumar, a 1995 batch Indian Police Service officer, has been appointed the new DGP, replacing SDS Jamwal

results.title: West Asia crisis: India ‘deeply concerned’ after seafarer killed in attack on merchant ship off Oman
results.content: The Ministry of External Affairs has condemned the death of an Indian seafarer in an attack on a commercial vessel off the coast of Oman, and called for an immediate de-escalation of tensions in West Asia.

results.title: Just want to play freely and give my best, says Lakshya
results.content: The Hylo Open trophy is a shot in the arm for the Indian badminton ace

results.title: Shift to Navi Mumbai or stop flying to Mumbai: Adani Airports CEO tells foreign airlines
results.content: Adani Airports Holdings CEO Arun Bansal says, “Like a landlord tells its airlines to vacate his property… we have told airlines you have to vacate from April. After that where you go is your choice.”

results.title: Weeks before expiry of Ganga Water Treaty, MEA says ‘structured mechanism’ remains in place for pact
results.content: MEA official spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal reiterates that India has invited the Bangladesh Prime Minister to visit New Delhi but that there is neither any ‘update’ on the treaty’s renewal nor on the dates for the trip
